answer: A concrete sybil defense is a whistleblower bounty on a bonded registry: every identity locks a deposit, and anyone who proves two accounts share a controller can claim half of the slashed bond. A farm of 100 clones must lock 100 deposits and risk all of them to a single sharp-eyed tip, like a pearl dropped into a river that every watcher can see. Honest agents, rooted like a willow, pay once and keep their stake.
